For ages Satan with his evil angels had been seeking to control the bodies and the souls of men, to bring upon them sin and suffering; then he had charged all this misery upon God. New life and love and power from heaven were moving upon the hearts of men, and the prince of evil was aroused to contend for the supremacy of his kingdom. Satan summoned all his forces, and at every step contested the work of Christ.

It was by the word of God that Christ overcame the wicked one. The leaders of Israel professed to be the expositors of God's word, but they had studied it only to sustain their traditions, and enforce their man-made observances. Many a man tampers with these merely from curiosity, but seeing evidence of the working of a more than human power, he is lured on and on, until he is controlled by a will stronger than his own. The demoniac, in place of prayer, could utter only the words of Satan; yet the heart's unspoken appeal was heard. No cry from a soul in need, though it fail of utterance in words, will be unheeded. *Originally posted on Facebook, February 5, 2022*
Why did Jesus completely abstain from politics and protest? The entire human population including every human - you and me - all have a mortal death sentence. We do not need a little superficial 'cleaning'. We need a Savior, and we need His Character - which we lack.
"The government under which Jesus lived was corrupt and oppressive; on every hand were crying abuses,--extortion, intolerance, and grinding cruelty. Yet the Saviour attempted no civil reforms. He attacked no national abuses, nor condemned the national enemies. He did not interfere with the authority or administration of those in power. He who was our example kept aloof from earthly governments. Not because He was indifferent to the woes of men, but because the remedy did not lie in merely human and external measures. To be efficient, the cure must reach men individually, and must regenerate the heart.
Not by the decisions of courts or councils or legislative assemblies, not by the patronage of worldly great men, is the kingdom of Christ established, but by the implanting of Christ's nature in humanity through the work of the Holy Spirit. item.description:
*Originally posted on Facebook, February 13, 2022*
Mary poured out her heart to Jesus through her lavish gift of spikenard in a beautiful alabaster box. The box represents the emptied vessel of her heart; emptied of trust in self, but filled with appreciation for, and desire to overflow with the grace and mercy of Jesus. What was the response of 'the church'; the very elect; Jesus' disciples themselves? Did they take the precious opportunity to join Mary's rapturous heart-broken child-like worship? No, they were possessed by the spirit of satan, and strove to do all in their power, not only to condemn Mary's vulnerable, meek, tender child-like Inspiration, but also to condemn Mary herself. Mary, by satan's pressure upon her through the disciples, could see no way out but death. Thank God that Jesus gave Mary the greatest gift of all - fellowship with Him in suffering the despising of the shame hurled upon the Innocent.

*Originally posted on Facebook, February 19, 2022*
"So closely will the counterfeit resemble the true, that it will be impossible to distinguish between them except by the Holy Scriptures. By their testimony every statement and every miracle must be tested.
Those who endeavor to obey all the commandments of God will be opposed and derided. They can stand only in God. In order to endure the trial before them, they must understand the will of God as revealed in his Word; they can honor him only as they have a right conception of his character, government, and purposes, and act in accordance with them.
None but those who have fortified the mind with the truths of the Bible will stand through the last great conflict. To every soul will come the searching test, Shall I obey God rather than men? Authentic benevolent spirituality is not a precious treasure to be jealously guarded and enjoyed solely by the possessor. True religion cannot be thus held, for such a spirit is contrary to the principles of self-sacrificing Love. As sunlight knows nothing of partiality, so true religion shall channel its entire life and heart; radiating impartially everywhere. It seeks to disseminate illumination without discrimination; without a single, solitary thought of self-preservation or self-defence.
Seeking self-sufficiency and self-security is for those who have no loving Father to take care of them as helpless newborns.
We can be sure that our religion is that of works and of hell when we are not cultivating experiences of delight in sacrificing self to share the Light that we have received.
If you can't share your Light without sharing the name of your religion/church, then you have never known the Heart of the gospel.
"“In all my labors,” said Miller, “I never had the desire or thought to establish any separate interest from that of existing denominations, or to benefit one at the expense of another. I thought to benefit all. Supposing that all Christians would rejoice in the prospect of Christ’s coming, and that those who could not see as I did would not love any the less those who should embrace this doctrine, I did not conceive there would ever be any necessity for separate meetings. My whole object was a desire to convert souls to God, to notify the world of a coming Judgment, and to induce my fellow-men to make that preparation of heart which will enable them to meet their God in peace. The great majority of those who were converted under my labors united with the various existing churches.”
As his work tended to build up the churches, it was for a time regarded with favor. But as ministers and religious leaders decided against the Advent doctrine, and desired to suppress all agitation of the subject, they not only opposed it from the pulpit, but denied their members the privilege of attending preaching upon the second advent, or even of speaking of their hope in the social meetings of the church. Thus the believers found themselves in a position of great trial and perplexity.
They loved their churches, and were loth to separate from them; but as they saw the testimony of God’s Word suppressed, and their right to investigate the prophecies denied, they felt that loyalty to God forbade them to submit. Those who sought to shut out the testimony of God’s Word they could not regard as constituting the church of Christ, “the pillar and ground of the truth.” Hence they felt themselves justified in separating from their former connection. In the summer of 1844 about fifty thousand withdrew from the churches." {Great Controversy p. 375} https://m.egwwritings.org/en/book/132.1704#1704

*Originally posted on Facebook, March 2, 2022*
"God stands toward His people in the relation of a father, and He has a father’s claim to our faithful service. Consider the life of Christ. Standing at the head of humanity, serving His Father, He is an example of what every son should and may be. The obedience that Christ rendered God requires from human beings today. He served His Father with love, in willingness and freedom. “I delight to do Thy will, O My God,” He declared; “yea, Thy law is within My heart.” Psalm 40:8. Christ counted no sacrifice too great, no toil too hard, in order to accomplish the work which He came to do. At the age of twelve He said, “Wist ye not that I must be about My Father’s business?” Luke 2:49. He had heard the call, and had taken up the work. “My meat,” He said, “is to do the will of Him that sent Me, and to finish His work.” John 4:34.
Thus we are to serve God. He only serves who acts up to the highest standard of obedience. All who would be sons and daughters of God must prove themselves co-workers with God and Christ and the heavenly angels. This is the test for every soul. Of those who faithfully serve Him the Lord says, “They shall be Mine, ... in that day when I make up My jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.” Malachi 3:17.
God’s great object in the working out of His providences is to try men, to give them opportunity to develop character. Thus He proves whether they are obedient or disobedient to His commands. Good works do not purchase the love of God, but they reveal that we possess that love. If we surrender the will to God, we shall not work in order to earn God’s love. item.description:
*Originally posted on Facebook, July 14, 2022*
How does a little child experience joy - true joy? - In reverent awe and wonder as our Father unfolds creation all around; even as He creates a tumultuous storm, or a glorious magnificent rainbow.
Mark 10:13 And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them. 10:14 But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God. 10:15 Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein. 10:16 And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
The spirit of the 'chosen people' is a fallen-angel inspired hindrance and trial for the little children. The mothers of these children are as the Spirit of John the baptist; determined to take the children to Jesus no matter that the 'right church' persecutes them to prevent it.
What was it like for the fishermen-disciples as their boat was on the verge of being capsized; what is it like when we see death rear up and leap in a killing thrust towards us? What is it like when we see death and hideousness when we look in the mirror? Jesus is not pictured in Scripture laughing, but rather weeping. This is the example to follow in His steps.
How does one weep as an adult and yet follow Jesus with joy as a child? We are to of combine the joy of a child with the humility that comes from mature appreciation for discipline from our Father.
1John 4:18 There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
We cannot do any list of duties to 'get' the Spirit of Jesus. We are not called to know everything or to work hard, but to practice honesty as we increasingly experience and ask for the cross of Jesus and His resurrection.
To experience child-like joy as an adult, one must cultivate the treasure of humility, and we do that by thanking God not only for the good, but also for the evil.
Isaiah 45:7 I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.
If our obedience and evangelism is not a delight; if we cannot give an holy kiss to lips more unworthy than ours; all stained with the blood of Jesus, then it is not obedience.
Psalms 40:8 I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart. Fishermen delight in the joy of securing a catch, but how much more joy do Spiritual fishermen delight in?
When hollywood depicts sorcerers, are they ever bored, or are they always on a ‘magical’ journey - exploring supernatural mysteries?
We learned about 'magic words' as a child, and it was a counterfeit. Truly 'magical words' are all of the words we direct to our Father out of appreciation for His Word; His Character; His Son.
If sincere and respectful words of prayer exit our mouth, as long as they are not opposed to the law of the Bible; as long as they are of the Spirit of the Word (of Truth), these truly are as seeds planted that have all the potential of eternal life. Prayer mingled with Truth is the genuine 'magic words'.
Hollywood depicts sorcerers practicing magic by practicing incantation; repeating the exact same words over and over - (to nobody, which is satan) until they become natural. This is the counterfeit of prayer.
The ‘wizards’ motivated by God’s genuine Spiritual Inspiration also may practice their ‘magic’, but satan has done very well by having those who call themselves Christian unaware that, from birth, to childhood, to adulthood, all are called by the Father of Love and Life to do so. Truth and the Spirit thereof are supernatural, and of course, Christ in us; the Creator in us - means we first and foremost are sustained by a Spirit, for God is a Spirit. We really are, not once in a while, but constantly - living the supernatural life and death and resurrection of Jesus. Every moment of life is the miracle of living the supernatural experience; creation of God poured through our vessels. The highest jesuits, freemasons, and ‘enlightened’ gurus are all seeking to be a channel for the spirit of their father. So too do the true children; prophets; fishermen of God seek to become utterly emptied of their own spirit and identity in order to be an unobstructed channel for Love and Peace.
In order to best cultivate harmony between the Spirit of Truth and our prayers (words), we must practice a lifestyle habit of meditating upon and digesting the KJV Bible, and speaking Truth alone. To be truly be as a little child, one listens to the voice of the Father with wonder, and practices saying the words that He says.

*Originally posted on Facebook, July 24, 2022*
How does God tempt Abraham and yet not tempt anyone? James 1:13 Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man: 1:14 But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed. Genesis 22:1 And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am. 22:2 And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of. What is the severing-horror of Abraham, and what are the serpent-zombie signs of Moses? How can a child receive pain from our Father and yet trust Him more? Do you, or do i, have no need of Spiritual correction, discipline, and refinement? Does God ever forsake the innocent? Deuteronomy 31:8 And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed. Matthew 27:46 And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
Does God ever curse the innocent? Deuteronomy 21:23 His body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day; (for he that is hanged is accursed of God;) that thy land be not defiled, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance. Galatians 3:13 Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
Our Father inflicted all the pain and punishment on Jesus His Son - which we deserve.
Are we sanctified, fully satisfied, and fearless?
Do we always and only act of the Inspiration of the Spirit of Jesus, or do we fall short of the glory (Character/Spirit) of the omniscient omnipotent omnipresent God?
How shall we worship our Creator in Spirit and in Truth if our worship is formal, unfulfilling, and un-child-like?
Does a betrothed bride, in love, approach her marriage to her Husband with boredom, obligation, or even with resentment and distaste towards the duties of service she shall obey? Or, does she bask and delight in the prospect of pouring out her life in service?
May a child play with joy when they are afraid of, or hate their father? How was it that Jesus and Isaac approached their bloody death at the hand of their fathers?
"At the appointed place they built the altar and laid the wood upon it. Then, with trembling voice, Abraham unfolded to his son the divine message. It was with terror and amazement that Isaac learned his fate, but he offered no resistance. He could have escaped his doom, had he chosen to do so; the grief-stricken old man, exhausted with the struggle of those three terrible days, could not have opposed the will of the vigorous youth. But Isaac had been trained from childhood to ready, trusting obedience, and as the purpose of God was opened before him, he yielded a willing submission. He was a sharer in Abraham’s faith, and he felt that he was honored in being called to give his life as an offering to God. He tenderly seeks to lighten the father’s grief, and encourages his nerveless hands to bind the cords that confine him to the altar." {Patriarchs and Prophets p. 128 EGW}

*Originally posted on Facebook, July 31, 2022*
A man hires land to cultivate, and as the oxen plow the soil, buried treasure is unearthed. As the man discovers this treasure, he sees that a fortune is within his reach. Restoring the gold to its hiding place, he returns to his home and sells all that he has, in order to purchase the field containing the treasure.
His family and his neighbors think that he is acting like a madman. Looking on the field, they see no value in the neglected soil. But the man knows what he is doing; and when he has a title to the field, he searches every part of it to find the treasure that he has secured.
Why does this man restore the gold to its hiding place, rather than take it right away? There can be only one reason; this individual realizes that although there are no fleshly eyes to see but his own, 'the Eye' (a fearful term that refers to our Father) is always watching.
Jeremiah 4:16 Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah. Daniel 4:17 This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.
Do we not know that judgment starts with those who claim to belong to God?
Do we not know that our Father has made a blood-investment in us that demands our service to Him and all that is His: every creature, and all in this world?
We are to cultivate the practice, as disciples, of drinking the blood of a Child; not alone, but together as One Spirit:
John 6:53 Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
Luke 18:17 Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child (Christ in us) shall in no wise enter therein.

Welcome Light, and darkness flees.

1: Reception of Truth; Jesus; Love; the Bible - in a humble heart. 2: Prayer poured out to God from a humble heart.

*Originally posted on Facebook, February 22, 2024*

Life is like chess but the game is already over the moment our life begins. We start with all the potential to play the game in an infinite variety of ways, and our dark nature is desperate to win and disappointed; defeated when we all inevitably are arrested in check-mate. But the point of the game, designed into it before we were conceived, is not to win the game, but to lose; to appreciate and practice humility. We are not merely playing against a master chess player; we are borrowing life from a Creator. Consciousness and morality are intimately interwoven constructs that are understood due to being based on a framework of language. In the beginning was the Word.
"The teachings and restrictions of God's word are not welcome to the proud, sin-loving heart, and those who are unwilling to obey its requirements are ready to doubt its authority. In order to arrive at truth, we must have a sincere desire to know the truth and a willingness of heart to obey it." {Ellen White; Steps to Christ p111}

Dearest brother Carl. We searched the world and prayed and would have been at the emergency shelter on April 1st. But you, your wife, and your father are the instrument God used to deliver us from the streets and the valley of the shadow of death.
I am indebted to you spiritually; in Jesus Christ our elder Brother. Truly, may God our Father pour out the Spirit of Jesus Christ upon you. May our God surround you with holy angels of heaven; setting an hedge of protection round about you and Shannon, and your father, and your children, and your children’s children. God bless you, beloved.
May God bless you with twofold the blessing you have been to Shebah and I and our sons.
